capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction legacy address enrichment
source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data report builder was run across all 250 priced, addressless Savills legacy appearances dated 2013 in AIDs 887, 889 and 892. Eighty-seven matches were retained only where the exact hammer price, locality or postcode district, tenure and property class aligned to one compatible transaction completing within 60 days of the auction. Ninety-three no-compatible-result, fifty-nine multi-candidate, three ground-rent and eight later-completion results were left unchanged. Original Savills/PropertyAuctions evidence and every repeat auction appearance remain preserved.
